question: Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G and L, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only three people sit between B and F when counted from the left of B. Only three people sit between D and E when counted from the right of E. G sits to the immediate right of D. C is an immediate neighbour of E as well as F. Who sits to the second to the left of L?
solution:

• Only three people sit between B and F when counted from the left of B.
 
• Only three people sit between D and E when counted from the right of E.
